interview.hardest_part: coordinating precise mouse clicks and keyboard inputs with real-time screenshot interpretation while managing day/night cycles and energy
interview.likely_failure: getting stuck in UI menus, misclicking interactive objects, or failing basic actions like tool selection due to lack of visual context
interview.helpful_mechanics: frequent auto-save system allowing restarts and forgiving exploration in an open world
interview.harmful_mechanics: long day cycles requiring careful energy planning from the start, complex bundle/quest systems with no initial tutorials, and the need to discover mechanics through trial and error
